Name: Full Inventory Toolbar (and Invisible Toolbar)
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=3]Makes your toolbar the size of your whole inventory, works best on a decently large monitor. Compatible with most backpack upgrade mods,
such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21591]The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades[/url]. ﻿

The enlarged toolbar behaves just like regular toolbar, you can click to select items, switch rows, and scroll through.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25711/25711-1719857547-1212226814.gif[/img][/size]


[size=3]You can also set a keybind to shift multiple bars at once, see Multi-Shift in config
[/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25711/25711-1720206141-1248248101.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
[size=3][u]Toolbar Arrangement[/u]: Makes the toolbar spread horizontally or stack vertically (see images)

[u]Toolbar Row Count[/u]: Limit number of rows on the toolbar, for use with backpack upgrade mods

[u]Multi-Shift[/u]: Shift multiple rows of the toolbar at once, not set by default.

[u]Multi-Shift Row Count[/u]: Number of rows to shift at once, default is entire toolbar.

[u]Hide Toolbar Boxes[/u]: Hide the boxes around each item (see images)

[u]Hide Toolbar Background[/u]: Hide the background for toolbar (see images)

By using [u]Hide Toolbar Boxes[/u] and [u]Hide Toolbar Background[/u] options together, the toolbar becomes invisible.
[/size]
[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25711/25711-1719857539-1867379955.png[/img][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b]
[/size][size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=3](Optional but recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for in game mod configs.﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]

[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11026]Toolbar Icons[/url]: If used together with vertical arrangement, this mod will offset the extra toolbars to allow space for the toolbar icons.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]﻿Bigger Backpack[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21591]The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades[/url]: Should be compatible, but you may want to limit the number of toolbar rows with the [u]Toolbar Row Count[/u] config.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]UI interface mods[/b] should all be compatible, as the invisible boxes/background feature is done by altering the game code rather than the loaded sprite.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4][b]Translations[/b] (just for config options, mod has no gameplay relevant text)
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]English[/size]
[*][size=3]Simplified Chinese[/size]
[/list][size=3]
